title: A2A and Enterprise Capabilities
summary: This module provides core functionalities for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, including authentication, communication protocols, and extensions. It also integrates enterprise-grade features like security, evaluation tools, and platform-specific actions.

nodes.label: A2A Authentication
nodes.title: Agent-to-Agent Authentication
nodes.description: Manages various authentication schemes (API keys, OAuth2, mTLS) for secure Agent-to-Agent communication, covering both client and server-side validation.

nodes.label: A2A Communication Core
nodes.title: Core A2A Communication Logic
nodes.description: Handles the fundamental aspects of Agent-to-Agent communication, including configuration, update mechanisms (polling, streaming, push notifications), and task delegation wrappers.

nodes.label: A2A Extensions & Utilities
nodes.title: A2A Extensions and Helper Tools
nodes.description: Provides advanced features and helper functions for A2A, such as Agent-to-Agent User Interface (A2UI) support, agent card management, gRPC authentication, and task execution utilities.

nodes.label: Enterprise & Evaluation Tools
nodes.title: Enterprise Features and AI Evaluation
nodes.description: Integrates CrewAI with enterprise platforms, offers tools for AI model evaluation using Patronus, and manages security configurations and tool access filters for robust, production-ready deployments.

groups.label: Agent-to-Agent Communication
groups.title: Agent-to-Agent Communication
groups.description: The foundational components enabling secure, configurable, and extensible communication between AI agents, supporting various protocols and advanced features like A2UI.

groups.label: Enterprise & Evaluation
groups.title: Enterprise Features and AI Evaluation
groups.description: Provides tools for integrating CrewAI into enterprise environments, including security controls, platform-specific actions, and robust AI model evaluation capabilities.
